encoding: JPEG, row 0 = north — same orientation as the heightmap
source: Digitale Orthophotos DOP20, Landesamt für Geoinformation und Landentwicklung Baden-Württemberg (LGL)
resolutionNote: The source is 20 cm. This drape is resampled by the WMS to about 18.4 m per pixel, because the terrain mesh beneath it is at 16 m posting and a 2-gigapixel texture is neither loadable nor useful. It is a photograph of the ground, not a measurement, and nothing is derived from it.
acquisition: LGL aerial survey; the flight date varies by tile
